title: Scarab of Neferu-Re
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
text: Name of the crown princess Neferure in a cartouche, combined with the priestess title and a wish formula: Divine consort: / Neferu-Re, / who may live.
original_inscription_field: [Translation] Name of the crown princess Neferure in a cartouche, combined with the priestess title and a wish formula: Divine consort: / Neferu-Re, / who may live.
geography: Egyptian collection; no exact findspot inferred.
provenance: Henry Walters, Baltimore [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: Museum supplies the three-line princess title, name and life formula, matching its stated inscription scope.
visual_observation: Full red carnelian underside photographed; three text zones and central cartouche visible. Glare and surface abrasion reduce contrast.
